middle_slides.text: 1837年、ロベルト・シューマンはクララ・ヴィークに結婚を申し込んだが、クララの父フリードリヒは猛反対しすぐに二人の交際を禁じた。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. A young Robert Schumann in his late twenties, standing alone outside the grand entrance of an elegant 19th-century townhouse at dusk in Leipzig, 1837. He has the same facial structure as the reference portrait — deep-set dark eyes, a broad face, a mustache — but youthful, with a full head of dark brown hair neatly combed back (no graying or receding hairline yet), smooth unlined skin. He wears a dark Romantic-era frock coat, waistcoat, and cravat. His posture is upright but his expression is troubled and dejected, gazing up at a closed upper-floor window of the house, hat in hand. Warm lamplight glows faintly from within the house, contrasting with the cool blue evening outside. No other people visible, no text.

middle_slides.text: 二人は手紙でひそかに愛を育んだが、1839年、シューマンはライプツィヒの裁判所に正式にヴィークを訴え、結婚の許可を求めた。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. He leans intently over a letter, quill in hand, surrounded by scattered papers and sealed envelopes tied with ribbon, a half-finished musical manuscript also visible on the desk. Through a window behind him, the silhouette of a stately courthouse building with classical columns is faintly visible under moonlight, symbolizing his legal petition. Warm candlelight illuminates his focused, earnest expression. No other people visible, no text.</br>

middle_slides.text: ヴィークは酒癖や経済力への疑念を並べ立てて1年以上徹底抗戦したが、1840年8月、裁判所はついに結婚を認める判決を下した。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Painterly historical illustration, not photorealistic: Friedrich Wieck, a stern, gray-haired German piano teacher in his early fifties (1840), with deep-set eyes, strong brow, long sideburns and a dark frock coat, standing in a Leipzig courtroom with wood-paneled walls, scowling, arms crossed. Not the same person as Robert Schumann. No text, no logos.

middle_slides.text: 翌9月12日、クララの21歳の誕生日の前日に二人は結ばれた。歓喜に沸いた1840年、シューマンは歌曲を140曲近く書き上げた。

His expression is radiant and full of happiness, eyes bright, a slight smile, as warm golden sunlight streams through a nearby window. A simple wedding band glints on his hand resting on the keys. 「忙しい大人のためのクラシック音楽ノート」では、忙しい日々の合間に、
ほんの数分だけ立ち止まりたくなる、クラシック音楽の物語を発信しています。
指揮者マエストロ・ノートが案内する、作曲家たちの知られざる人生の
ドラマ——栄光の裏にあった挫折、常識をくつがえす意外な真実——を、
毎日少しずつお届けしています。

難しい知識は必要ありません。ただ、物語として楽しんでいただければ、
それだけで十分です。

他の作曲家の逸話も知りたい方は、チャンネルもチェックしてみてください。https://youtube.com/@classicalmusic_note?si=evg6wej2KOx2uPhH
